description: This file defines a custom adapter 'DaysAdapter' for a RecyclerView in an Android weather app. It fetches daily weather data from a remote API using Volley, parses JSON responses, and binds the data to view components to display weather forecast details for multiple days. The class manages network requests, data parsing, UI updating, and view holder definitions relevant to displaying forecast information.

classes.name: DaysAdapter
classes.description: Custom RecyclerView.Adapter to display daily weather forecast in a list, fetching data via Volley and binding weather info to UI components.

classes.name: DaysAdapter.DayViewHolder
classes.description: View holder class holding references to UI components within each day item view for efficient RecyclerView rendering.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the day_item_layout and creates a new DayViewHolder instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Fetches weather data for the given position and binds it to the view holder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the fixed count of 6 days for the forecast list.

methods.name: getDailyWeatherInfo
methods.description: Makes a network request to fetch weather data for a specific day, parses the JSON, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: updateUI
methods.description: Updates the view holder's views with the parsed weather data.

methods.name: hideProgressBar
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator and displays the forecast layout after data load.
